description: Nature hero, approved look direction: vine greens, bark browns, fresh-leaf accents; pale sapwood face mask with glowing eye sockets so the face reads at tactical zoom.

head_mask.note: pale sapwood mask - the face read

eye_glow.note: back of the eye holes, soft green glow

torso.note: bark core (neck, shoulders, trunk under the leaves)

braid.note: vine braid across the chest (darker than the leaf tabard so it reads)

vine_tip.note: new-growth vine tips (blended over the last third)
